description: Append-only queue of flag-don't-fix / deferred decisions. New entries are appended; existing entries are never mutated in place.

queue.rationale: A clean uninstall inverse is impossible without a generation-time pre-image/backup, which would be a RUNTIME change out of SP-8's no-behavior-change scope — merge-action hooks in a possibly-preexisting settings.json can't be safely un-merged; add-header/modernize mutate files in place with no saved pre-image; origin:adopted artifacts must never be touched; seed-if-absent docs may be user-edited.
queue.resolution: Deferred to a possible future minor (a new skill + 3 doc inventories + a skill-count test, not a patch). Recorded as an onboard 3.1.1 breadcrumb in onboard/CHANGELOG.md so the decision is durable and visible in the PR.

queue.title: Wave-4 candidate (SP-11+) — close the 'gate that cannot fail' class across onboard's test/gate surface
queue.rationale: Three P5 review rounds each fixed instances of one failure mode — a gate/fixture/belt that reports success without exercising what it claims — and each fix left the class alive one file over. Deferred as a dedicated hardening sprint rather than chased instance-by-instance inside the diet, per developer decision at the round-3 gate. NONE breaks shipped behavior; all are latent guard gaps.
items: R3-SP8-01: check-ref-paths.sh's .json coverage is unfalsifiable — tests/ref-paths/test-check-ref-paths.sh has no .json arm; reverting the feature leaves all belts green. Add resolving/dangling .json fixtures; assert BROKEN count.

R3-RISK-1 / CORR-F1: check-ref-paths.sh reports an unearned pass on a missing ROOT (sibling check-phase-numbering.sh got the guard this round; this one didn't). Also its root-relative branch is CWD-relative and exempts the 4 research-schema .json refs it was added for. Add the -e ROOT guard; convert the 4 to citing-file-relative or a named exemption list.

R3-SP8-03: the lookalike exemption swallows a dangling .json whose basename is absent under onboard/ — catches a RELOCATION but not a RENAME/TYPO. Make onboard/schemas/*.json refs non-exemptible, or allowlist the generated-into-target basenames.

R3-SP8-04: the numbering self-test derives its per-violation list from the fixture, so gutting bad-steps.md to 1 line keeps the belt green (55->46 ok, no FAIL). Pin the expected violation count per fixture.

R3-CORR-F2 / TEST-1: the schema parity belt asserts 'byte-identical accept/reject' but checks only required[]/additionalProperties — 6 malformed shapes flip ACCEPT->REJECT invisibly. Replace with a real HEAD-vs-new differential over an instance corpus; add named-key reject fixtures.

R3-RISK-2: the restored Research self-audit (and start's prose generally) is pinned only by the CI-excluded release-gate; every belt guard on start/SKILL.md is a don't-grow ratchet. Add a must_present_nonempty verbatim pin (the pattern already used for generate's 5 safety strings).
R3-SP8-06 / CORR-F5: check-phase-numbering.sh reports a pass over an existing-but-empty ROOT (zero .md files). Count scanned files; fail on zero.
R3-CORR-F4: unspaced em-dash (**Step 8—Verify**) false-flags an in-family label. Strip trailing em-dash-and-beyond before shaping.
R3-CORR-F7: indented headings and paren-delimited ordered lists evade declaration detection. Allow ^[[:space:]]{0,3}#{1,6} and [0-9]+[.)].
R3-TEST-2: the ordered-list declaration form has only positive coverage; add an ordered-list violation to bad-steps.md.
R3-PRIN-1: the belt re-asserts ref integrity the dedicated CI job already owns (belt:98-102) — duplicate assertion site the belt's own header disclaims. Delete it.

release-gate: run-automated-checks.sh is excluded from run-all.sh discovery, so it caught a dropped instruction CI could not (U6). It also hardcodes versions (drifts each sprint) and launders check-schemas exit 2 as a warning. Make it CI-discoverable, derive its version pins from plugin.json, and bring its exit-2 to parity with the belt's hard-fail.
